task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of my living room light and get its current mesh snapshot. After that, archive that snapshot with the title "System Light State Archive" for user_1234, analyze the text "mesh_light_archive_native", and verify the light's status again. Finally, create a backup of the "/systems/iot/lighting_configs" workspace named "weekly_iot_backup".
